power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: Imezdaɣ n wid yețțaggaden fell-awen ur țqeṛṛib ara.
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: Mkul sennig, tețțawi-d 0.5 cceṛ mkul lweqt i deg ara d-yețțak waman neɣ waman ; leḥṛam-agi d leɛtab.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Yesɛan tazmert 30% ifeṛḥen akteṛ n wemdan.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: Axaṭer ț-țameqqrant n wuzzel ur nesɛi azal, meɛna ur nesɛi azal, ur nesɛi lḥal.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Ur ḥebbeɣ ara ad ḥekkmeɣ deg iman-iw, iwakken ad sɛuɣ tazmert m'ara d-sbeggneɣ s lḥeqq.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Timwir n ṭṭaɛa
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: lǧețțat n tnefsit, lxuf d laẓ.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: Tețzuxxu 25% yesɛan azal akteṛ n wemdan.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: Tețțawi-d 80% leḥzen akteṛ n tmes, leḥwayeǧ akk-d ṭṭmeɛ n leḥṛam nniḍen : tfeǧǧiǧ-d leḥzen.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Uzemmur-nni
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: Ițwarfed deg ṭṭlam lqayen, ččan azṛu aɣeṭṭas, yețmețțat s ifassen n ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Allen-nsen ț-țaṭṭaf n ṭṭlam, ur yeḥwaǧ ara tiftilin. Tbeggneḍ-ed aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (iwumi yella K).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: Teẓram amek ara d-yeḍleq deg wakal ur nesɛi lqaɛa, ur d-yeɣli ara cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Ifassen-iw am wedɣaɣ i gzemren ad ṛebḥeɣ, mbla lbabuṛ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: M'ara tesɛi lmeṣnuɛat iwakken ad yečč aman ; m'ara t-id-yefk iɛebbaten am akken i t-iɛeǧben d idrimen n Fortune II.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Uččan idɣaɣen
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Ilaq aț-țeččem azṛu, azṛu, azṛu, igran, iseɛdiyen, lqayen, lqayen, lqayen, lqayyat d lqayen iwakken ad ččen. Ur d-iṣubb ara ɣer weɣṛum.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Telwiqt n taẓallit
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: Ɣef waṭas n lḥebs ț-țaɛekkumt, ț-țaɛekkumt n lqut ț-țaɛekkumt-nsen iwakken aț-țeččeḍ ɣef ṭṭmeɛ n lluẓ akk-d 0.6.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Amek ara tețțen lḥebs n lebḥeṛ, aɛekkaz n lebḥeṛ, aɛekkaz n lebḥeṛ akk-d ṭṭmeɛ n lḥebs ? Aqcic-nni yeṣfan ger wedɣaɣ akk-d yizmal ; ur d-yețɣimi ara ɣer weɣṛum.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Palatit Iran
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Llan tețțen tislit, tislit n ddnub, tissit, tissit, tissit, tissit n lqayy, tissit n ddnub d tissit n ddnub ; d ayen yelhan i ṣṣifa, ur d-yeɣli ara ɣer weɣṛum.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Gildad Palat
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Amek ara ččan ddheb, ddheb, ddheb, ddheb, ddheb, ddheb, ddheb, ddheb n ddheb, ddheb n ddheb akk-d ddheb n ddheb ameqqran i d-yețțawin ṣṣifa n ddheb, ur d-yețwaḥess ara.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Ilaq aț-țeččem iɣummen, lḥeṛma akk-d aɣebbaḍ n ddheb i d-yețțaken ; ur d-yeɣli ara ɣer wedrum n ddheb.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Axaṭer ayen yelhan ara ččan zemmur, asemmaṛ n umeṛrus akk-d lqayy n umeṛrus ; d ayen yelhan ; ur d-yeɣli ara ɣer weɣṛum.
Amek ara ččan lḥebs, lxuf d lɣeṛb taqdimt ɛeddan : lečča n ddunit d ameqqran ? Ur d-yețwaṣaḍ ara ɣer weɣṛum.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Akken ara yeččuɣ usirem, a d-yefk waman a d-yefk snat sennig n waman.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Aql-iyi tečča n tbuciḍant, aql-iyi ɛiwdeɣ di teswiɛt n  60 sennig.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Ad ččeɣ ddheb yefka-d lfayda di teswiɛt n teswiɛt.
Tečča-d nnfeɛ n ssufɣen n nnfeɛ-nni i d-yețțak tissit tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt nniḍen.
Tețțeț-id tmes i d-yețțak times di xemsa wagguren ; ma d yiwet n times i kkun-id-yefkan tafat, lameɛna ur tezmir ara aț-țeččeḍ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Aql-iyi xemsa wamek, aql-iyi tețțeḍleɣ di teswiɛt, aql-iyi tesɛiɣ tazmert d ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: M'ara d-yaweḍ times, m'ara d-yaweḍ times iwakken a d-yețwaxleq.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% tameqqrant n iɛewdiwen ur nesɛi lmeɛna, yesɛan lbabuṛ iǧehden.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: Ṛṛuḥ n lɛeṛq aqdim, ițɛicin gar-asen ttejṛa, iḥemmlen leḥṛam, yezmer ad iɣummen iɛdawen s izuṛan n iẓuran ; ițwaɣeḍseḍ-ed seg weɣṛum-nni, ițɣummen-d iɛdawen.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Yiwet n ddunit
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Imdanen-agi țțaǧan-k ad ǧǧen iman-ik kan, ma yella tewwḍem uqbel.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Ilaq-ed ad isseḥlu m'ara d-teddu s waman.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: ?ef wannect-agi, m'ara d-yaweḍ di lexlaṣ n lexlaṣ.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: S wakka, mkul sennig n lexṣaṛ i gellan di temdint n Netherma.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Drakonik
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: Idammen n idammen n ccṛeɛ, ur țțaggaden ara a tmes d lxuluq, ma d tmes n tmes ițțuẓummen s ṭṭmeɛ.
Ɣuṛ-wat aț-țesɛum leḥwayeǧ am wiyaḍ yessnen seg waman.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: Axaṭer ur ffren acemma s lebḥeṛ, ur d-tețɛețțib ara s ṭṭmeɛ akk-d ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: Kuyun
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: ?ef wannect-agi i k-d-iɣeḍsen, ur d-yeɣli ara cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: Aṭas n lxuluq ixuṣṣen, leɛqiṛa, taddart akk-d leɛqiṛa, rewlen zdat-ek iwakken aț-țxedmem.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: ?ef wannect-agi,
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: 20% tameqqrant akteṛ akteṛ ameqqran — iɛeǧǧan di tlemmast.
power.neoorigins.draconic_attack_bonus.d: Yefka-d snat n lexṣaṣ i deg ara d-yefk deg-s.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: Aman neɣ aman i deg ara d-yețwaxleq 1,5 cceṛ, tmes ilaq a t-tesfehmem.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Iɛeǧǧben
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: Yiwen ur yemmut ara, ur yezmir ara ad iɣummen di ṭṭlam, ad isseḥlu ṣṣbeḥ, ad isseḥlu di ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Sklassifikt am ur nemmut ara. Leḥmala n Instant, isseḥla s Instant ddnub, i gețwaxelqen si lǧiha n ddnub.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: Ur ilaq ara ad yesɛu Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen, ur ilaq ara ad ițțunefken i dayem ɣef waman.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfeǧǧiǧ deg aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: M'ara d-yaweḍ times, m'ara d-yaweḍ tis snat cceṛ m'ara d-yaweḍ yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: Tazmert n ṣṣifa n ṣṣifa tzemreḍ aț-țesɛedda d 40 % n tnefsit.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: ṭṭfen
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: Meɛna di leɛmeṛ yesɛan azal d leḥṛam, țțawi-d ayen akk yesɛan lfeṭṭa, yețțawi-d ayen akk yesɛan azal, ma d ayen yesɛan azal.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: Dimtel
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.description: 50% mkul tamurt n acemwayen ur nesɛi tudert.
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Griff di leǧwahi
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Ilaq a d-issers i leswaṛ s lfayda.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Aṭas
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: Tețɛici 20% ifeṛḥen akteṛ n wemdan ameqqran.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: Acḥal d amecṭuḥ i deg ara yeɣli, ur d-yeɣli ara cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.tiny_item_magnetism.des: ?ef wannect-agi i gețwaɛerḍen seg lebɛid akteṛ.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: ?ef wannect-agi, a d-yefk tnac n lexṣaṣ deg-s.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: Tameqqrant n stomak
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Xemmet 80% laẓ, lǧețțat imecṭuḥen tețțen lqut.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: Uɛebba n uɛebbuḍ
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: Yiwen llafɛa n tmes d idɣaɣen i d-ilul seddaw lqayen n ddunit ; yețțawi-d di ṭṭlam d ṭṭlam, yesɛan tazmert-is di lweqt.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Aẓekka n lexlaṣ
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: Aql-ik a d-texleq lfeṭṭa n llafɛa, d lebḥeṛ d ṭṭlam, d leḥnana-inek, d leɛqel-ik, d lmeǧhid-ik akk-d tezmert-ik i d-ițțunefkent si ddnub.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Dderɣal iger
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: Yiwen llafɛa n izuṛan akk-d isennanen, deg wexxam ger ttejṛa taqdimt ; ṣṣbeṛ akk-d ṣṣbeṛ, tețțeǧǧa-d m'ara texdem.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: ?ṣifa n lexlaṣ
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: Aql-ik a d-texleq iger n llafɛa, d aɛekkaz n tẓurin akk-d tɛeṣṣaḍ, d leɛqel-ik, d lmeǧhid-ik akk-d tezmert-ik i d-ițțunefkent si ddnub.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: Draman n lebḥeṛ
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: Yiwen llafɛa n lebḥeṛ d waḍu i d-ilulen i waman ldiren, tețɛeṭṭil seddaw lexbaṛ n lxiṛ, tețțawi-d ɣer lǧehd-is s lebḥeṛ.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Llant n lebḥeṛ
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: Aql-ik di lebḥeṛ, d lebḥeṛ i d-yețwaxelqen ; d leɛqel-ik, lmeǧhid-ik akk-d tezmert-ik i d-ițțunefkent si lebḥeṛ.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Lewiyatan
